title: The Zero Tech Debt Mandate
facebook_comment_text: 💡 The true cost of "quick fixes" isn't just future refactoring; it's the lost market share from delayed features and crippling developer burnout. Sustainable engineering isn't a luxury; it's your greatest competitive advantage. 🤔 For tech leaders, what's been your biggest challenge in shifting mindset from short-term velocity to long-term code health?
